description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git branch command options, primarily focusing on various scenarios involving branches, contains, no-contains, merged, and no-merged options, as well as some branch tracking and verbose output assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects successful execution, setting up the environment, running the commands, and checking outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output with the expected output.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the repository's timestamp or state to simulate passage of time for commits.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository with specified changes.
